objectives.description: Use French greetings and self-introduction phrases correctly in oral exchanges
Conduct simple dialogues on familiar topics including family, school, colours, and food
Express frequency of activities using adverbs (souvent, parfois, toujours, jamais)
Invite someone, accept and refuse invitations, ask for permission, and give advice in French
Give directions, explain a procedure, and respond to commands and prohibitions in French
Describe people, objects, weather, and situations using appropriate French vocabulary and structures

subStrands.name: Numbers, Time, Family, and Daily Life

objectives.description: Count and use numbers 1–100 and apply arithmetic operations in French
Name days of the week, months of the year, and express dates and seasons in French
Identify and describe family members, relationships, and household objects in French
Name food items, meals, and market goods and use these in practical French conversations
Use classroom objects, colours, and descriptive adjectives correctly in French sentences
Read simple French texts and answer comprehension questions on content and vocabulary
Write simple sentences, short paragraphs, and guided compositions in French on familiar topics
Perform role plays on practical situations including transport, market shopping, and restaurant visits
Understand and follow simple recipes, procedures, and instructional texts written in French
Prepare and respond to guided oral and written French exercises as exam preparation
